items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.
Experience independently managing multiple priorities, deadlines, and confidential personnel matters while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
Experience with databases; desktop computer proficiency, including word processing, email, calendaring software, internet research, and spreadsheets, and the ability to learn complex systems.

The Human Resources Support Analyst within the Shared Services team provides human resources and academic personnel support, serving as an operational liaison between the Colleges, Undergraduate Education (UE), Divisional Academic HR, Staff Human Resources, and other participating divisions. The position delivers responsive, high-quality customer service while applying established university policies, procedures, and labor regulations to HR operations and personnel transactions.
Familiarity with compliance tracking, reporting, or audit support.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively as a member of a team.
Knowledge of UC policies, procedures, and HR systems.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Problem solving skills with the ability to think critically, analyze data, and use sound judgment in responding to issues.
Working knowledge of HR policies and processes
Demonstrated written communication skills, with the ability to explain HR policies and procedures clearly to diverse audiences.
Demonstrated verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain HR policies and procedures clearly to diverse audiences.
Demonstrated ability to provide responsive customer service and build effective working relationships with employees, managers, and organizational partners.
